en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a low, modernist brick building in a lightly wooded rural setting. The single‑storey structure has a tiled gable roof with two prominent square chimneys and several rectangular windows. A small entrance canopy is visible near the center. In the foreground are rough ground, grass, and trees; in the background, beyond birch and conifer trees, lies a small town with a hilltop church whose tower with a spire rises above the treeline. The overall atmosphere suggests a quiet Nordic countryside institution or community building.
